runtimeBoundary: Only current executable hashes are sealed. The historical contract recorded versions, not binary/OS/native-library hashes; historical binary identity remains unknown. This is development mixed-origin evidence, not formal identical-runtime proof.
fingerprintMeaning: Derived executor and all historical data dependencies; 2880 historical controls are reused under their original 113-source/runtime/row origins, not freshly run under the new 115-source policy snapshot. Only 960 V8 games are new policy executions.

schedulingAmendmentBeforeExecution.reason: Actual author's read-only full 2880-cache check took 62.651s; ten groups amortize repeat validation while preserving the identical full grid and results-independent scheduling. No V8 game or partial score has run.

statistics: Six fixed comparisons, all 12 official panels (72 comparisons/504 income), four-seat sensitivity (24 comparisons/168 income); 24 equally weighted configurations within each seed, sample SE of 40 seed means, exploratory mean +/-1.96SE. No favorable-panel selection or partial-score inspection, no formal acceptance threshold.
firstDivergenceGate: For V8 minus V7 every first divergence must have equal public view/prefix, evaluated actor's discard response with legal hu, and different actions one of which is hu. Any other first divergence requires explanation before comparison.
failurePolicy: Stop launching on any failed child; let already active children close normally. Preserve every attempt/output/log. No automatic retry, fallback, replacement seed, score-dependent scheduling or resumed partial output. A retry needs a new declared same-seed attempt and preserved failed source identity.
evidenceAfterAllGames: Check complete origin ledger/raw/result grid, every cached historical byte, stored-action legal-state replay and invariants, six fixed comparisons/all 12 official panels/seven income/four-seat sensitivities, complete V8/V7 first-divergence scope, independent arithmetic. No partial strength score inspection.
